Title: EVT-OP-021: The critical case κ = 1 of the power-lag echo process
Labels: open-problem, area:dependence, type:research, difficulty:medium, status:research

**Status in the survey:** Formally open in the library. This is an internal gap, not a problem stated in the literature, and it completes the answer to Bai–Kulik–Wang.

## Source and quote
## Why it matters
It would finish the description of the transition at the critical block length.

## What the library already has
`powEchoProcess_critical`, in `Dependence/EchoPowerLag.lean`, for the other values of `κ`.

## What is missing
The boundary case. Read the hypotheses of `powEchoProcess_critical` to see what fails at `κ = 1`.
